blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Calls for solidarity and prayers for peace rang out loud across the southern Philippines as the 2026 Mindanao Week of Peace (MWOP) commenced on Thursday. Themed “Many Journeys, One Humanity: Building Peace,” the 2026 MWOP will run until December 2, with key cities Cotabato, Davao, Zamboanga, Marawi, Pagadian, and Cagayan de Oro, among others, celebrating the occasion with different activities. READ: ‘Week of Peace’ highlights interfaith solidarity in Mindanao The MWOP started in 1997 through the efforts of the Zamboanga City-based Peace Advocates Zamboanga.
